subject: A fixed, airy 16:9 chalkboard knowledge-explainer composition with three deliberately asymmetric clusters and extensive untouched board space. In the upper-left quadrant, from roughly 12% to 47% of the frame width and 10% to 43% of the height, draw a waist-up young office man overwhelmed at a desk. His hair and suit jacket are board-green negative space bounded by thin ivory contours, not dark filled masses. His tapered face, ears, and two hands are small warm-peach flat fills. Give him short grouped fringe, rectangular glasses, worried brows, and a small open mouth. One hand holds a phone and the other is near a laptop. Surround him with three empty speech bubbles containing only tiny coral dots, a small paper chart with coral nodes and arrows, a neat stack of papers, a small steaming cup, and a few coral alert marks. Keep the laptop body and papers unfilled board-green inside their ivory outlines; only the phone screen is a small coral fill. In the upper-right quadrant, from roughly 55% to 88% of the frame width and 10% to 38% of the height, draw a second waist-up young office explainer. Use the same board-negative hair and suit treatment, peach face and hands, and rectangular glasses. He makes a small open-palmed gesture beside a thin ivory-axis line chart with sparse coral nodes and a coral downward arrow. Below the chart is a single row of simple ivory outlined person icons, with only the last icon marked in coral. Add two or three small coral question marks above his head. In the lower-left-to-center cluster, from roughly 14% to 52% of the frame width and 46% to 82% of the height, draw a long-haired female investigator in three-quarter view. Her long hair and dark jacket remain board-green inside thin ivory contours; fill only her face and hand in peach, her inner top in muted violet, and a tiny flower badge in mustard yellow. She holds an ivory-outlined magnifying glass toward one small round spiky microbe character: leave its body board-green with ivory outline, give it only tiny coral facial details. Beside it, place one tiny full-body office boy and a small ivory flow diagram. Keep the entire lower-right half quiet and empty. Use fine, smooth ivory contours throughout; all marks are diagrammatic and text-free.
